home.design_description: Every space at Charlie M is designed with your stay in mind. From the layout to the details, everything is considered to make your time here feel comfortable, easy, and well put together. Calm, welcoming details shape the experience. Materials, light, and flow come together quietly, creating places where you can slow down, settle in, and simply feel good during your stay.

items.title: How does the online check-in work?
p: At Charlie M, the online check-in is a quick digital step that makes your arrival completely smooth and contactless.

After you book, we'll send you a link where you can securely confirm your details and complete the mandatory registration. This allows us to verify your identity, prepare your stay, and activate your personal access PIN.

**Once your online check-in is finished, your PIN will be sent to you on the day of your arrival. You'll receive it by email and Whatsapp, and it will give you access to both the building and your room.**
Because we don't have a reception on-site, the online check-in must be completed before you arrive — otherwise we won't be able to generate your access code

items.title: When will I receive my access PIN?
p: Your access PIN is generated only after you complete the online check-in. You'll receive it on the day of arrival by email and Whatsapp, typically by early afternoon. This PIN is needed to enter both the building and your room.

items.title: Which doors can I open with my PIN?
p: Your personal PIN gives you access to everything you need during your stay. With this code, you can open the main entrance, your room door, the laundry room, and the luggage locker room. No keys or cards needed—just one PIN for all areas.

items.title: Can I store my luggage in the hotel?
p: We offer secure free luggage lockers in the building where you can store your bags before check-in or after check-out. If no lockers are available at the moment, you'll find a nearby alternative at Stasher Luggage Storage, Friedrichstraße 56, 10117 Berlin.

items.title: How do I contact support if I need help?
p: If you need help at any time, our team is available 24/7. You can send us a message on WhatsApp, or call us directly by phone. We're always here to support you during your stay.

items.title: How often is my apartment cleaned?
p: Your apartment is thoroughly cleaned and prepared before your arrival. For stays longer than 7 nights, we offer a complimentary weekly cleaning. If you'd like an additional refresh at any time, you can book an extra cleaning for X.

items.title: Where can I get fresh towels and extra amenities?
p: You're welcome to take fresh towels and extra amenities from our Essentials Closet whenever you like. It's available and free for you at all times.

items.title: Is smoking allowed?
p: Smoking inside the room is strictly forbidden. It's only allowed on private balconies or on the shared terrace. If your room doesn't include these outdoor spaces, please smoke outside the building.

items.title: Can I do my laundry in the hotel?
p: Absolutely. A guest laundry room is available on-site, so you can wash your clothes whenever you need.

items.title: Which extra services are available at the hotel?
p: We offer several extra services to make your stay even more comfortable, including breakfast, parking, early check-in, late check-out, and special packages. You can book any of these extras directly on our website or simply add them to your existing reservation.

items.title: Are pets allowed?
p: Yes, pets are welcome! We charge a one-time fee of X for the entire stay, and your fluffy friend can enjoy the trip with you.

items.title: How do I change or cancel my reservation?
p: If you booked directly through the Charlie M website, you can easily change or cancel your reservation in your guest account.
For flexible rates, any eligible refund will be automatically returned to your original payment method.

If your booking was made through a partner platform (such as Booking.com, Airbnb, or Expedia), please make any changes or cancellations directly on that platform. Refunds will also be handled by the provider you booked with.

items.title: When can I receive my invoice?
p: You can receive your invoice after your stay. As soon as you check out, your invoice will be available for download in your user cabinet or can be sent to you upon request.

content.title: Provider / Contractual Partner / Scope
paragraphs: 0.1 The contractual partner for all bookings and services is exclusively:
MBoutique GmbH & Co. KG Nazarethkirchstraße 51, 13347 Berlin, Germany Email: info@charlie-m.de

0.2 These General Terms and Conditions apply to all agreements for the paid provision of hotel rooms for accommodation ("Units") and all related services ("Accommodation Agreement") between MBoutique GmbH & Co. KG ("Charlie M") and the customer/guest ("Guest").
0.3 Any conflicting or supplementary terms and conditions of the Guest shall not apply unless Charlie M has expressly agreed to their validity in text form.
0.4 The property is operated as a classical hotel / accommodation business. Use for residential or permanent living purposes is neither owed nor intended.

content.title: Conclusion of Contract / Minimum Age / Bookings by Third Parties
paragraphs: 1.1 By completing a booking, the Guest submits a binding offer to conclude an accommodation agreement. The contract is concluded once Charlie M confirms the booking in text form (e.g. by email) or once the booking is technically confirmed.
1.2 Minimum age: Bookings are permitted only for persons 18 years of age or older.

1.3 Bookings by third parties: If a third party books on behalf of a Guest (e.g. a company booking for employees), the third party shall be jointly and severally liable together with the Guest for all obligations arising from the accommodation agreement, insofar as the third party acts as the booking party and/or makes the booking in its own name.

content.title: Booking Channels / Priority of OTA Rules
paragraphs: 2.1 Bookings may be made via the Charlie M website as well as via third-party providers (e.g. OTAs such as booking platforms).

2.2 Bookings via third-party providers: If a booking is made via a third-party provider, the booking and cancellation conditions displayed and accepted during the respective booking process shall additionally apply. In the event of conflicts between third-party conditions and these GTC, the third-party conditions shall prevail in the relationship between Guest and third-party provider; in the relationship between Guest and Charlie M, these GTC shall apply insofar as mandatory third-party rules do not prevail.

content.title: Prices / Taxes / City Tax (Berlin)
paragraphs: 3.1 The prices displayed at the time of contract conclusion shall apply.
3.2 City Tax / accommodation tax:
• For bookings made via third-party providers (OTAs), the City Tax is included in the price.
• For bookings made via the Charlie M website, the City Tax is shown separately and charged additionally, insofar as it is applicable under the respective legal provisions.

3.3 Statutory taxes or charges may change. Charlie M is entitled to adjust prices if taxes, fees or levies are changed or newly introduced after the conclusion of the contract and the period between contract conclusion and service provision is not merely short-term. Any price adjustment shall be limited exclusively to the objectively increased costs.

content.title: Payment Terms (Advance Payment / Payment Methods)
paragraphs: 4.1 Advance payment: The total booking amount is always payable in advance.
4.2 Time of charge: Payment is charged immediately upon booking.
4.3 Payment methods: Only card payments and wallets via the payment service provider (e.g. credit/debit card, digital wallets) are accepted. Bank transfers and cash payments are excluded.

4.4 Charlie M is entitled, in the event of violations of these GTC or subsequent costs (e.g. damages, contractual penalties, special cleaning, emergency or service costs), to charge the Guest's stored payment method with the outstanding amounts, insofar as legally permissible.

content.title: No Claim to a Specific Room / Upgrade / Relocation
paragraphs: 5.1 There is no entitlement to a specific unit or room number; the booked room category is owed.
5.2 Charlie M is entitled to assign the Guest an equivalent or higher-value room (upgrade).
5.3 In the event of technical issues or operational reasons, Charlie M is entitled to relocate the Guest within the property. Accommodation outside the property is not owed.

content.title: Cancellation / No-Show / Early Departure / Group Bookings / Trade Fair & Event Periods
paragraphs: 6.1 Rate structure: Charlie M offers refundable and non-refundable rates. The applicable cancellation periods result from the rate policy displayed during the booking process.
6.2 No-show (failure to arrive):
• Refundable/Flexible Rate: The first night will be charged; remaining nights may be released.
• Non-refundable/Prepaid Rate: 100% of the booking amount will be charged.
6.3 Early departure: In the event of early departure, the entitlement to the full booking amount remains (100% of the booked service), unless mandatory statutory provisions provide otherwise.
6.4 Group bookings: A group booking exists from five (5) units onward. Separate payment and cancellation conditions may apply and will be set out in the respective offer or agreement in text form.
6.5 Trade fair / event periods: The respective rate policies apply. Deviating cancellation periods will

content.title: Check-in / Identity Verification / Access (100% Digital)
paragraphs: 7.1 The property is operated 100% digitally. A physical on-site check-in is not owed.
7.2 Online check-in is mandatory for access to the unit.
7.3 Identity verification:
• The main guest must verify their identity during online check-in using a valid identification document.
• Additional guests must be registered by name; ID verification for all accompanying guests is not mandatory unless required by law.

7.4 Failed verification: If the identity of the main guest cannot be reliably verified (e.g. missing/invalid documents or suspected manipulation), Charlie M is entitled to cancel the booking and deny access.
7.5 Minors: Minors may stay only when accompanied by or under the responsibility of an adult guest.

content.title: Digital Keys / Access Data / Logs / Misuse
paragraphs: 8.1 Access is granted via digital keys/access data that are limited in time to the check-in and check-out period.
8.2 Prohibition of sharing: The sharing of access data/keys with third parties is prohibited. The mere act of sharing constitutes a breach, even without resulting damage.
8.3 Misuse/manipulation: In the event of misuse, manipulation, unauthorized sharing or security concerns, Charlie M is entitled to block access and terminate the stay.

8.4 In the event of a breach of the prohibition on sharing access data, Charlie M is entitled to charge a contractual penalty of EUR 300.00. Independently thereof, the Guest shall be liable for all additional costs incurred, in particular for measures to restore security (e.g. blocking or reissuing digital keys, lock management, service or technical interventions).
8.5 Access logs: Access events may be logged for security purposes.

content.title: House Rules: Smoking Ban / Parties / Quiet Hours / Fire Alarm System
paragraphs: 9.1 Smoking ban: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the units and all indoor areas (including e-cigarettes). Violations will be penalized with a contractual penalty of EUR 300.00. Further claims for damages (e.g. odor removal, textile cleaning, loss of use) remain reserved.

9.2 Fire alarm system: If a fire alarm is triggered due to culpable behavior of the Guest (in particular smoking), the Guest shall additionally owe a flat fee of EUR 1,500.00, without prejudice to the proof of higher actual costs (e.g. fire brigade deployment).
9.3 Parties/events: Parties and events are prohibited. In case of violation: contractual penalty of EUR 300.00 plus damages (e.g. additional cleaning, inventory damage, loss of revenue).
9.4 Quiet hours: Night-time quiet hours apply from 10:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m. Noise disturbances must be avoided.

content.title: Visitors / Additional Persons / Commercial Use
paragraphs: 10.1 Visitors: Visitors are not permitted. Access is granted exclusively to the guests listed in the booking.

10.2 Prohibition of commercial use: Any commercial use of the unit is prohibited, in particular paid services, treatments or offerings within the room (e.g. massages, escort/sex services, coaching or consulting with clients, photo or video recordings for commercial purposes, events of any kind).

10.3 Contractual penalty: In case of violation of Section 10.2, a contractual penalty of EUR 500.00 shall apply. In addition, Charlie M is entitled to terminate the stay immediately and claim further damages.

content.title: Damages / Special Cleaning / Guest Surveillance Equipment
paragraphs: 11.1 The Guest shall treat the unit with due care.
11.2 Special cleaning: In the event of excessive soiling or extraordinary cleaning effort, Charlie M may charge a minimum fee (e.g. from EUR 50.00) as well as additional costs based on actual effort.

11.3 Damages/theft: The Guest shall be liable for damages and losses caused by the Guest or by third parties to whom the Guest has granted access. Compensation may also include loss of use, insofar as legally permissible.

11.4 Prohibition of guest-operated cameras: The operation of cameras or surveillance equipment by Guests within the unit is prohibited. In case of violation, Charlie M may terminate the stay and claim costs and damages.

content.title: Pets
paragraphs: 12.1 Dogs may be permitted for a one-time fee per stay, provided this option is offered during the booking process or in the user cabinet. Bringing pets without prior booking or approval is not permitted. No fee exemption is granted, including for assistance or service dogs, as increased cleaning and hygiene efforts apply regardless of the type of animal.

content.title: Cleaning / Housekeeping / Access for Maintenance
paragraphs: 13.1 Cleaning is carried out upon departure.
13.2 For stays of more than seven (7) nights, an additional weekly cleaning is carried out. Additional cleanings may be booked for a fee, if offered.
13.3 Mandatory cleaning: For stays of 7+ nights, cleaning is mandatory. If the Guest refuses cleaning, a contractual penalty of EUR 200.00 shall apply.

13.4 Maintenance/technical access: The Guest must tolerate access for maintenance or technical work after at least 12 hours' prior notice. In urgent cases (imminent danger, safety or damage prevention), access is permitted without prior notice.

content.title: Luggage Lockers / Laundry Rooms / Parking / Bicycles
paragraphs: 14.1 Luggage lockers and laundry rooms are provided for use where available. Use is at the Guest's own risk. Charlie M assumes no liability for loss, theft or damage, insofar as legally permissible.
14.2 Parking/bicycle spaces: Use is at the Guest's own risk. Charlie M assumes no liability for break-ins, theft or damage, insofar as legally permissible.

content.title: Lost Property
paragraphs: 15.1 Lost property is stored for six (6) months.

15.2 Shipping is carried out only upon request. A handling fee of EUR 30.00 applies. Shipping within Germany is charged at a flat rate of EUR 15.00 (up to 20 kg). European and worldwide shipping is charged according to DHL tariffs.

content.title: Internet / Wi-Fi
paragraphs: 16.1 Charlie M provides internet access within the scope of technical availability; disruptions may occur.
16.2 Misuse is prohibited, in particular illegal file sharing, illegal streaming and the retrieval or distribution of unlawful content. The Guest is obliged to respect the rights of third parties.
16.3 The Guest shall indemnify Charlie M against claims by third parties arising from unlawful use, insofar as legally permissible.
16.4 Charlie M is entitled to block internet access in the event of misuse.

content.title: Force Majeure / Unavailability
paragraphs: 17.1 In the event of force majeure or events not attributable to Charlie M (e.g. fire, water damage, power outage, official orders, pandemics or other operational disruptions), Charlie M may suspend services in whole or in part.
17.2 In such cases, already paid amounts for services not rendered shall be refunded where appropriate; further claims for damages are excluded, insofar as legally permissible.

content.title: Termination / House Rules Enforcement / Eviction
paragraphs: 18.1 Charlie M is entitled to terminate the accommodation agreement without notice for good cause, in particular in cases of violence, drug trafficking, prostitution or paid sexual services, serious rule violations, misuse of access data, parties, significant noise disturbances or security risks.
18.2 In such cases, Charlie M may demand immediate vacating of the unit and block access.
18.3 Eviction without refund + damages: In the event of culpable behavior by the Guest, Charlie M may (a) refuse any refund and (b) additionally claim damages, insofar as legally permissible.

content.title: Resale / Subletting / Assignment
paragraphs: 19.1 The resale of bookings, subletting, onward distribution or assignment of claims is prohibited.
19.2 In case of violation, Charlie M is entitled to cancel the booking; any entitlement to a refund shall be excluded, insofar as legally permissible.

content.title: Registration Law / Residence Registration
paragraphs: 20.1 Registration of the unit as a place of residence is generally not permitted.
20.2 Exceptions require the prior written approval of Charlie M.
20.3 In the event of a violation, Charlie M may terminate the stay and claim costs and damages.

content.title: Communication / Text Form / Language
paragraphs: 21.1 Booking confirmations sent by email are binding.
21.2 WhatsApp communication may be used for support purposes; contractual amendments require text form (e.g. email), unless expressly confirmed otherwise by Charlie M.
21.3 Operational communication may also take place in English. The German version of these GTC shall be legally binding.

content.title: Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: Charlie M is prepared to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board, insofar as this is legally provided for or appropriate in individual cases.

content.title: Final Provisions / Jurisdiction / Severability
paragraphs: 23.1 German law shall apply to the exclusion of the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).
23.2 In commercial transactions, the place of jurisdiction is Berlin. For consumers, the statutory places of jurisdiction apply.
23.3 Amendments and supplements require text form (email is sufficient), unless a stricter form is prescribed by law.
23.4 Should any provision of these GTC be or become invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall remain unaffected. The statutory provision shall apply in place of the invalid provision.

content.title: Controller
paragraphs: The controller within the meaning of Art. 4 No. 7 GDPR is:
MBoutique GmbH & Co. KG Nazarethkirchstraße 51 13347 Berlin Germany
Email: info@charlie-m.de
An internal data protection officer has been appointed. The data protection officer can be contacted via the above address.

content.title: Scope of this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy informs you about the processing of personal data in connection with:
• the operation of our website,
• booking and provision of hotel accommodation,
• the fully automated check-in process,
• the use of digital access systems,
• communication with guests (email, telephone, WhatsApp),
• payment processing,
• analysis and optimisation of hotel operations.
Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

content.title: Legal Bases for Processing
paragraphs: We process personal data exclusively in accordance with the GDPR, in particular on the basis of:
• Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR - consent
• Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR - performance of a contract / pre-contractual measures
• Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR - legal obligation
• Art. 6(1)(d) GDPR - legitimate interest

content.title: Minors
paragraphs: Our services are directed at adults.
Minors may only stay at our hotel when accompanied by their legal guardians.
No independent processing of personal data of minors takes place.

content.title: Booking and Stay
paragraphs: In the context of booking and accommodation, we process in particular the following data:
• first and last name
• email address
• telephone number
• billing and, if applicable, company address
• stay details (arrival and departure dates, room assignment)
• booking and payment references
Purpose: Conclusion, performance and settlement of the accommodation contract.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.

content.title: Legal Registration Obligations (German Federal Registration Act)
paragraphs: For guests who are not German nationals, registration data is processed in accordance with Sections 29 et seq. of the German Federal Registration Act (Bundesmeldegesetz).
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR in conjunction with Sections 29 and 30 BMG.
Retention period: One year from the date of departure; deletion within three months thereafter.

content.title: Property Management System (Apaleo)
paragraphs: For the management of bookings, stays, guest data and internal hotel operations, we use the property management system apaleo GmbH.
Provider: apaleo GmbH Dachauer Straße 15A 80335 Munich Germany
The following personal data is processed via Apaleo in particular:
• name
• contact details
• booking and stay information
• room and stay allocation
• billing and, where applicable, company information
Purpose: Proper management of hotel operations and performance of accommodation contracts.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Apaleo acts as a data processor within the meaning of Art. 28 GDPR.
A corresponding data processing agreement has been concluded.
Processing takes place exclusively on servers within the European Union.

content.title: Digital Check-in (Guestway)
paragraphs: We use Guestway to provide a fully automated check-in process.
The following data may be processed:
• name
• contact details
• booking and stay information
• identification data (uploaded or manually entered), where required
Purpose: Execution of the check-in process and fulfilment of legal obligations.
Legal bases: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR
Identification data is stored only for as long as legally required and then deleted.
The check-in process is fully automated.
No automated decision-making within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR takes place.

content.title: Digital Access Systems (SALTO KS)
paragraphs: We use SALTO KS for digital access control.
The following data is processed:
• guest name
• stay period
• room allocation
• access logs (time and date of door access)
Purpose: Security, traceability and proper hotel operation.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Access logs are stored only for a limited period and deleted unless security-related incidents require longer retention.
Access is restricted to management only.

content.title: Payment Processing (Adyen)
paragraphs: Payment processing is carried out via Adyen.
Adyen acts as an independent controller within the meaning of the GDPR.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
We do not receive complete payment details (e.g. full credit card numbers).

content.title: Communication with Guests
paragraphs: We communicate with guests via:
• email
• telephone
• WhatsApp Business (via WhatsApp Ireland Ltd. and Twilio)
Communication serves:
• performance of the accommodation contract,
• handling of enquiries,
• guest support during the stay,
• post-stay communication (e.g. feedback).
Legal bases: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (WhatsApp)
Consent to WhatsApp communication may be withdrawn at any time.

content.title: Automated Messages and Service Analysis
paragraphs: Pre-stay, during-stay and post-stay messages may be sent automatically.
Support enquiries are stored and analysed to improve service quality and internal processes.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

content.title: Website Use and Log Files
paragraphs: When visiting our website, the following data is processed:
• IP address
• date and time of access
• accessed pages
• browser and operating system data
Purpose: Ensuring stability and security of the website.
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

content.title: Google Analytics
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics exclusively with IP anonymisation enabled.
• no profiling
• no remarketing
• no merging with other data
Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent).

content.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use:
• technically necessary cookies (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR),
• analytics cookies only with consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

content.title: Hosting and Backups
paragraphs: Data processing takes place exclusively on servers located within the European Union.
Regular backups are created and deleted after defined retention periods.

content.title: Retention Periods
paragraphs: Personal data is deleted once the respective purpose no longer applies and no statutory retention obligations exist.

content.title: Rights of Data Subjects
paragraphs: Data subjects have the right to:
• access (Art. 15 GDPR)
• rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
• erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
• restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
• data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
• objection (Art. 21 GDPR)
• withdrawal of consent at any time (Art. 7(3) GDPR)

content.title: Supervisory Authority
paragraphs: Berlin Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information
https://www.datenschutz-berlin.de

content.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy with effect for the future in the event of legal or technical changes.
